hero.label: Medically Led Implementation Platform

hero.body: Cell Clinics connects partner practices and clinics with Cell Education training and practice resources. Each practice remains responsible for its own treatment decisions.

lab.label: Longevity Lab
lab.title: This Was Longevity Lab 2026
lab.body1: A focused day on cellular medicine, longevity and human performance, connecting medicine, science, elite sport and entrepreneurship in Mallorca.
lab.body2: Longevity Lab Mallorca in motion. The official recap film captures the energy of the scientific morning at Estadi Mallorca Son Moix and the evening exchange at Mallorca Country Club.

implementation.label: Central Model Clinic
implementation.title: One Of Our Central Partners
implementation.subtitle: Gais, Switzerland
implementation.poweredBy: Member of the Cell Clinics network
implementation.body1: As a central partner clinic within the Cell Clinics framework, this site demonstrates how physician-guided cellular medicine, biological diagnostics, regenerative medicine and premium clinical care can come together inside one operational center.
implementation.demonstratesBody: The Cell Clinics model helps healthcare providers implement structured cellular medicine programs within existing practices and clinics.
implementation.demonstratesBody2: This includes physician education, diagnostic frameworks, clinical pathways and implementation support.
implementation.poweredBody: Cell Clinics provides the educational, diagnostic and implementation frameworks that enable healthcare providers to build structured cellular medicine programs inside their own clinical environments.
implementation.poweredBody2: Resources must be adapted to each practice's qualifications, professional scope and circumstances.

ecosystem.label: Partner Ecosystem
ecosystem.title: Knowledge and support for your practice
ecosystem.body1: Join an implementation platform designed for physicians, clinics and healthcare professionals.
ecosystem.body2: Cell Clinics connects practices with training, resources and professional exchange. The scope and schedule of cooperation are agreed individually.
ecosystem.card1Body: Comprehensive physician education through Circle, Campus, infusion training, webinars and continuous scientific updates.
ecosystem.card2Body: Standardized clinical frameworks, treatment concepts and implementation protocols for integrating cellular medicine into everyday practice.
ecosystem.card3Body: Diagnostic information to support individual professional assessment.
ecosystem.card4Body: Information on materials and equipment. Training conveys knowledge, not purchasing rights or a commitment to any pharmacy.
ecosystem.card5Body: Become part of an international community of physicians, clinics, researchers and longevity experts.
ecosystem.card6Body: Marketing resources, patient education and implementation support to successfully establish cellular medicine within your practice.
ecosystem.ctaTitle: More Than Products. More Than Education.
ecosystem.ctaBody: Cell Clinics is a complete implementation platform that helps healthcare providers successfully integrate cellular medicine into clinical practice through education, diagnostics, clinical systems and an international expert network.

platform.label: How The Platform Works
platform.title: One Integrated Ecosystem For Modern Cellular Medicine
platform.body: Cell Clinics connects education, diagnostics, clinical systems, products and an international physician network into one implementation platform. Every component is designed to support healthcare providers throughout the entire patient journey.
platform.module1Body: Scientific education and continuous physician training.
platform.module3Body: Information for diagnostic interpretation and professional assessment.
platform.module4Body: Orientation on practice materials and processes.
platform.closingBody: Cell Clinics is more than a collection of products or educational programs. It is an integrated platform that brings together every element required to successfully implement cellular medicine in clinical practice.

systems.label: Knowledge and workflows
systems.title: Four topics for professional exchange.
systems.card1Body: Training topics covering cellular metabolism and mitochondria.
systems.card2Body: Assessment of medical history and findings within each profession’s permitted scope.
systems.card3Body: Documentation and discussion of individual observations.
systems.card4Body: Workflows for information, appointments and documentation.

leadership.label: Medical Leadership
leadership.title: Medical Leadership
leadership.body: Cell Education teaches cell biochemistry. Cell Clinics connects this training with exchange between partner practices.
leadership.stat1Body: Training conveys knowledge about diagnostics and treatment concepts. It does not confer a professional qualification or authority to treat.
leadership.stat2Body: Structured workflows connect assessment, physician interpretation and therapeutic implementation.
leadership.stat3Body: Training and professional exchange connect participants from different countries.
leadership.stat4Body: Professional exchange on cell biochemistry and diagnostic questions.
leadership.cardBody: Medical education and clinical framework development for cellular medicine implementation.

onboarding.label: Partner Onboarding
onboarding.title: Step by step towards collaboration
onboarding.body: Preparation, training and a possible start are agreed individually with your practice.
onboarding.step1Body: Access, responsibilities and the implementation timeline are established.
onboarding.step2Body: Your team, materials and digital presence are prepared.
onboarding.step3Body: Training, diagnostics and clinical workflows are introduced.
onboarding.step4Body: Your clinic launches and joins the Cell Clinics network.
onboarding.support: After launch: ongoing training, scientific updates and implementation support.

nikiciuk.profileTitle: Recognising inflammatory disease early and treating it precisely
nikiciuk.profileBody: Rheumatism is an umbrella term for numerous inflammatory diseases affecting joints, connective tissue and blood vessels. The practice combines careful internal and rheumatological assessment with modern diagnostics and treatment planning tailored to disease stage, findings and each patient's individual situation.

nikiciuk.area2Body: Joint ultrasound, joint aspiration, laboratory testing and collaborative X-ray diagnostics provide a sound basis for medical decisions.
nikiciuk.area3Body: Care for connective tissue diseases, vasculitis, rare conditions and possible renal involvement within an internal-medicine context.
nikiciuk.area4Body: Medication, infusion therapies, nutritional advice and patient education are combined where clinically indicated.

nikiciuk.stage3Body: Findings and individual circumstances inform a carefully tailored treatment plan.
nikiciuk.stage4Body: Regular reviews monitor progress and enable medically necessary adjustments.

hero.label: For patients
hero.title: Bionic Cell Therapy. Professional support, near you.
hero.body: Cell Clinics connects medical practices, dental practices, clinics and Heilpraktiker practices. Check each practice's profession and services. Medical services reserved for physicians may only be provided by physicians.

therapy.label: Cell Education · Bionic Cell Therapy
therapy.title: Get to know the concept.
therapy.intro: Bionic Cell Therapy is a treatment concept that supports cell function. No cells are transferred. It is not stem cell, fresh cell or gene therapy.
therapy.card1Body: Discuss your questions and individual circumstances with a practitioner.
therapy.card2Body: Existing findings and your history can help assess your starting situation.
therapy.card3Body: A personal consultation can clarify whether an examination or treatment may be appropriate.
therapy.card4Body: The treating practice explains alternatives, limitations, possible risks and costs.

process.label: Your treatment pathway
process.title: How do I access Bionic Cell Therapy?
process.intro: Four clear steps from your first inquiry to ongoing support — all at a Cell Clinic near you.
process.step1Body: Select a partner practice and check its professional category and services.
process.step2Body: Your practitioner takes time to understand your medical history, concerns and goals. Together, these create a clear picture of your individual starting point.
process.step3Body: Your practitioner discusses which examinations may be appropriate and how findings can be interpreted.
process.step4Body: Agreed treatment takes place in the practice. The treating practice discusses further consultations and any follow-up assessments with you.

trust.item4Body: Scientific exchange and continuous professional dialogue across the international Cell Clinics network.

faq.label: Frequently asked questions
faq.title: What you may want to know before your first consultation.
faq.intro: Answers about the practice network and an initial consultation.
faq.q1: Who may be suitable for Bionic Cell Therapy?
faq.a1: Only a practitioner can discuss whether the concept is appropriate for your personal circumstances after an individual assessment. This website does not recommend treatment. Medical services reserved for physicians may only be provided by physicians.
faq.a2: Like any medical procedure, an infusion can have side effects. Your practitioner will personally explain the procedure, benefits and possible risks beforehand and decide whether it is suitable for you.
faq.q3: What does treatment cost, and is it covered by insurance?
faq.a3: The practice explains expected costs before treatment. Physicians' services in Germany are billed under GOÄ. Please check possible reimbursement with your insurer in advance.
faq.a4: Duration, appointments and scope depend on individual decisions and the practice's services. Please discuss these questions directly with your practitioner.
faq.q5: How is a Cell Clinic different from a conventional practice?
faq.a5: Cell Clinics is a practice network. Cell Education provides training. Membership and training do not replace professional licensing or independent quality assessment. Each practice is responsible for its own treatment.
